USER PROFILE
------------
NAME: Samet Erkan Boz
LOCATION: Istanbul
TITLE: Full Stack Developer

ABOUT
-----
Since July 2024 I have worked at beije, a period care brand that sells by subscription.
I started with landing pages and now own platform work across a monorepo
of Next.js apps and NestJS services.

EDUCATION
---------
BSc in Computer Engineering, Istanbul Gelişim University (2020 - 2024)

EXPERIENCE
----------
Full Stack Developer at beije (2024 - present)
- beije.co storefront
- ruuts.xyz storefront
- admin panel, backend services, end-to-end tests

Frontend Developer at kargakarga (2024)

Full Stack Intern at Kafein (2024)

Projects.heading: Work at beije, July 2024 to today

items.name: The customer storefront
items.description: I have been the most active developer on beije.co since 2025. I built campaign and landing pages, the cart and checkout with 3D Secure and one-time-password payments and saved cards, subscription editing, skipping and cancelling, and the customer return request flow from the form to the emails.

items.name: A new admin panel
items.description: I moved the legacy operations panel to a new Next.js panel: order queues with bulk actions, refunds and returned orders, promo codes and coupons, label and invoice printing, customer and review moderation. One codebase serves two brands, runs in Turkish and English, and shows each admin only the screens their permissions allow.

items.name: A platform upgrade across the monorepo
items.description: I led the move of all seven frontend apps to React 19, Next.js 16 and MUI 9 in two weeks, with ESLint 9 flat config and a newer Nx on the way. I also wrote the migration guide for the team.

items.name: End-to-end tests on the whole stack
items.description: I wrote most of the storefront's Cypress suite in my first months, then set up Playwright for the admin panel. The suites run in CI against a local Docker stack with seeded data and a payment sandbox, so a broken checkout fails a pull request before it reaches a customer.

alsoItems.name: ruuts.xyz
alsoItems.description: Most of the brand-specific features of ruuts, beije's sub-brand for shaving products: the starter kit builder, subscriptions that start on a future date, and sign-up with a beije account.

alsoItems.name: Localized errors for every service
alsoItems.description: The shared library that gives about ten NestJS services error and validation messages in the user's language, with numbered error codes.

alsoItems.name: Design tokens from Figma
alsoItems.description: Color, type and spacing tokens generated from the Figma design system, a lint rule that rejects hard-coded values, and one library of about 1,400 icons that take their color from the text around them.

alsoItems.name: Backend services
alsoItems.description: One-time passwords over SMS with rate limiting, login history, moderation APIs for the community, admin permissions, and shipping carrier integrations with label printing.
